kubectl -n telemetry-629c get sts influx -o jsonpath='{.spec.volumeClaimTemplates[0].spec.resources}{"

sleep 20; kubectl -n telemetry-629c get pvc data-influx-0 -o jsonpath='{.spec.resources.requests.storage} {.status.capacity.storage} {.status.conditions}{"\n"}'
